from collections import deque
def flood(g, bg, fill):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; q=deque()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in (0,W-1):
            if g[r][c]==bg and not seen[r][c]: seen[r][c]=True; q.append((r,c))
    for c in range(W):
        for r in (0,H-1):
            if g[r][c]==bg and not seen[r][c]: seen[r][c]=True; q.append((r,c))
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft(); g[r][c]=fill
        for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]==bg and not seen[nr][nc]:
                seen[nr][nc]=True; q.append((nr,nc))
    return g
